summary_en: 118,200 shares (0.7% of shares outstanding) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-07 at 4,230 yen/share closing price. Settlement same day. Part of larger 526,000-share authorization (3.2% S/O, 2.0 billion yen limit) with execution window 2026-08-07 to 2026-12-30 via open market and trust-bank methods.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares via off-exchange purchase transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-06, Fukuda Corporation's board of directors authorized acquisition of treasury shares. This notice announces a single block transaction executed on 2026-08-07 via ToSTNeT-3 (off-exchange purchase trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange). The company will place an order to purchase 118,200 shares (0.7% of shares outstanding as of 2026-07-01) at the closing price of 4,230 yen per share, in the 08:45 time slot. The purchase order is limited to that single trading window with no possibility of rerouting to other trading systems or times. Results will be announced after the 08:45 session closes. This block purchase is part of a broader board authorization covering up to 526,000 shares (3.2% of S/O) with a maximum aggregate price of 2.0 billion yen, to be executed between 2026-08-07 and 2026-12-30 via open-market methods including ToSTNeT-3 and trust-bank arrangements.
